# IMAP prompts and progress use localized folder names while diagnostics keep URIs

Delete confirmation, percent-progress text and multi-message copy status use GetLocalizedName in UTF-16 formatting arrays. Copy status obtains the value from dstFolder. The changed diagnostic logs instead use mURI directly. This preserves the existing stored-name/display-name distinction without renaming a folder or changing its protocol identity. The source adds no locale or UI regression test.

Scope: IMAP user-facing folder-name formatting.
